job: Enter a short code from a message or an app.
purpose: Six single-character boxes that behave as one field. Typing advances, Backspace steps back, arrow keys move, and pasting fills every box; SMS autofill lands in the first. fd:change fires on every edit with { value, complete }: verify when complete is true. In a posted form it keeps one named input and a hidden input carries the whole code.
useWhen: A verification code arrives by SMS, email or an authenticator app.
A code of fixed length is typed or pasted once (data-length, data-type).

avoidWhen.when: The value is a number people adjust.
The value is a long key or token.

states.name: invalid
states.how: aria-invalid="true" on the boxes; set by your app after a wrong code

variants.useWhen: A sign-in or checkout step where the code is the one task.

parts.role: The wrapper; carries data-fd-otp and data-length.
A separator between groups of boxes.

keyboard.does: Clears the box, or steps back to the previous one.
Jump to the first or last box.
